<?php
/** Automatically stage SOL Inbound Monologue on the disposable Playground demo. */
add_action(
	'admin_enqueue_scripts',
	static function () {
		if ( ! function_exists( 'desktop_mode_is_enabled' ) || ! desktop_mode_is_enabled() ) {
			return;
		}
		wp_add_inline_script(
			'desktop-mode',
			'window.wp.desktop.ready(function(){var key="sol-im-playground-staged";try{if(window.sessionStorage.getItem(key)){return;}window.sessionStorage.setItem(key,"1");}catch(error){}if(window.wp.desktop.widgetLayer){window.wp.desktop.widgetLayer.ensureMounted("feed-buddy/buddy-list");}window.setTimeout(function(){window.wp.desktop.openWindow("feed-buddy-reader",{source:"playground-demo"});},350);});',
			'after'
		);
	},
	100
);
